desc:
A physics sandbox full of realistic Dummies that feel every hit. Wound them and they hunch, limp, crawl or fight back.

🦴 Break bones with shots, blows, falls and crashes
🔫 Unlock 40+ weapons with Bones, from pistols to black holes
⚙️ Toss subjects into the blender, press, lava and human cannon
☄️ Buy server events: meteors, tsunami, black hole or a nuke
🏆 Top the Most Bones and Time Played leaderboards
